title: Even moments of a Bernoulli sign variable
statement: Let $q\in[0,1]$ and let $m$ be a natural number. If a Bernoulli bit is $1$ with probability $q$ and $0$ with probability $1-q$, then the expectation of the $(2m+2)$-nd power of the variable that equals $0$ for bit $1$ and $-1$ for bit $0$ is $1-q$.
